parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The name of the user group to query. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query.  
The maximum value of PageSize is 100. The default number of entries per page is 20. If PageSize is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
> Do not leave PageSize empty.

parameters.name: PagingOff
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to disable paging. Valid values:

- **true**: Disables paging and returns all data.

- **false**: Enables paging and returns the number of user groups specified by PageSize.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
